statement: For each ordered pair of actual String instances of length 0 through 3 over a and b, the public apply method returns the length of the longest common subsequence.

assumptions.text: The parameters are those of the adapter entry score.LcsScore#score(II)I. adapter/score/LcsScore.java maps 0 through 14 bijectively to the fifteen strings and invokes the selected public method. adapter/score/ScoreOracle.java enumerates subsequences independently.
